arguments.content:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate an academic conference poster for the Nature 2024 neural circuit mapping study.
Version 3 — properly fills A0 portrait canvas."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import os
import random

# ─── Dimensions & Colors ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
W, H = 3500, 4950

BG_NAVY       = (10, 16, 34)
BG_CARD       = (20, 32, 60)
BG_CARD_LIGHT = (26, 40, 72)
ACCENT_BLUE   = (0, 155, 255)
ACCENT_TEAL   = (0, 210, 185)
ACCENT_GOLD   = (255, 195, 40)
ACCENT_CORAL  = (255, 110, 100)
TEXT_WHITE     = (242, 247, 255)
TEXT_LIGHT     = (195, 205, 225)
TEXT_MUTED     = (120, 138, 170)
BORDER_SUBTLE  = (38, 58, 98)

FONT_DIR  = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/liberation"
FONT_DIR2 = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu"

def load_font(name, size):
    for d in [FONT_DIR, FONT_DIR2]:
        p = os.path.join(d, name)
        if os.path.exists(p):
            return ImageFont.truetype(p, size)
    return ImageFont.load_default()

# ─── Fonts — larger to fill A0 ─────────────────────────────────────────────
font_title       = load_font("LiberationSans-Bold.ttf", 136)
font_subtitle    = load_font("LiberationSans-Regular.ttf", 62)
font_citation    = load_font("LiberationSans-Italic.ttf", 44)
font_section     = load_font("LiberationSans-Bold.ttf", 78)
font_metric_val  = load_font("LiberationSans-Bold.ttf", 120)
font_metric_lbl  = load_font("LiberationSans-Regular.ttf", 40)
font_metric_ctx  = load_font("LiberationSans-Italic.ttf", 30)
font_body        = load_font("LiberationSans-Regular.ttf", 46)
font_body_bold   = load_font("LiberationSans-Bold.ttf", 46)
font_body_small  = load_font("LiberationSans-Regular.ttf", 38)
font_bullet      = load_font("LiberationSans-Regular.ttf", 42)
font_table_head  = load_font("LiberationSans-Bold.ttf", 40)
font_table_val   = load_font("LiberationSans-Regular.ttf", 36)
font_footer      = load_font("LiberationSans-Italic.ttf", 34)
font_method_lbl  = load_font("LiberationSans-Bold.ttf", 38)
font_method_desc = load_font("LiberationSans-Regular.ttf", 32)
font_callout     = load_font("LiberationSans-Bold.ttf", 42)
font_badge       = load_font("LiberationSans-Bold.ttf", 28)
font_imp_body    = load_font("LiberationSans-Regular.ttf", 40)

# ─── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def draw_rounded_rect(draw, xy, radius, fill=None, outline=None, width=1):
    draw.rounded_rectangle(xy, radius=radius, fill=fill, outline=outline, width=width)

def tw(draw, text, font):
    bb = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=font)
    return bb[2] - bb[0]

def th(draw, text, font):
    bb = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=font)
    return bb[3] - bb[1]

def draw_text_wrapped(draw, text, x, y, max_width, font, fill, line_spacing=12):
    words = text.split()
    lines = []
    current = ""
    for word in words:
        test = (current + " " + word).strip()
        if tw(draw, test, font) <= max_width:
            current = test
        else:
            if current:
                lines.append(current)
            current = word
    if current:
        lines.append(current)
    for line in lines:
        draw.text((x, y), line, font=font, fill=fill)
        y += th(draw, line, font) + line_spacing
    return y

def draw_accent_line(draw, x0, y, x1, color=ACCENT_TEAL, width=3):
    draw.line([(x0, y), (x1, y)], fill=color, width=width)

def centered_text(draw, text, cx, y, font, fill):
    w = tw(draw, text, font)
    draw.text((cx - w // 2, y), text, font=font, fill=fill)

def draw_vertical_gradient(draw, xy, color_top, color_bot):
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = xy
    for y in range(y0, y1):
        t = (y - y0) / max(1, y1 - y0 - 1)
        c = tuple(int(color_top[i] + (color_bot[i] - color_top[i]) * t) for i in range(3))
        draw.line([(x0, y), (x1, y)], fill=c)

# ─── Create Image ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG_NAVY)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

draw_vertical_gradient(draw, (0, 0, W, 600), (22, 38, 72), BG_NAVY)

margin = 140
content_w = W - 2 * margin

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# HEADER
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
draw.rectangle([0, 0, W, 12], fill=ACCENT_BLUE)

y = 80

# Nature badge
draw_rounded_rect(draw, (margin, y, margin + 200, y + 50), radius=10, fill=ACCENT_GOLD)
centered_text(draw, "NATURE", margin + 100, y + 8, font_badge, BG_NAVY)
draw.text((margin + 220, y + 4), "2024", font=font_citation, fill=TEXT_MUTED)
y += 75

# Title
draw.text((margin, y), "Mapping Neural Circuit Architecture", font=font_title, fill=TEXT_WHITE)
y += 170
draw.text((margin, y), "Advances in Brain Connectivity Analysis", font=font_subtitle, fill=ACCENT_TEAL)
y += 85

# One-liner
draw_text_wrapped(draw,
    "A comprehensive study revealing new principles of neural circuit organization through "
    "large-scale connectomics and functional mapping.",
    margin, y, content_w, font_body_small, TEXT_LIGHT, line_spacing=10)
y += 80

# DOI
draw.text((margin, y), "DOI: 10.1038/s41586-024-07487-w", font=font_citation, fill=ACCENT_GOLD)
y += 60

draw_accent_line(draw, margin, y, W - margin, ACCENT_BLUE, 3)
y += 50

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# METRICS BANNER
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
banner_y0 = y
banner_h = 440
draw_rounded_rect(draw, (margin, banner_y0, W - margin, banner_y0 + banner_h),
                  radius=22, fill=BG_CARD, outline=BORDER_SUBTLE, width=2)

draw_accent_line(draw, margin + 25, banner_y0 + 10, W - margin - 25, ACCENT_GOLD, 2)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate an academic conference poster for the Nature 2024 neural circuit mapping study.
Version 3 — properly fills A0 portrait canvas."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import os
import random

# ─── Dimensions & Colors ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
W, H = 3500, 4950

BG_NAVY       = (10, 16, 34)
BG_CARD       = (20, 32, 60)
BG_CARD_LIGHT = (26, 40, 72)
ACCENT_BLUE   = (0, 155, 255)
ACCENT_TEAL   = (0, 210, 185)
ACCENT_GOLD   = (255, 195, 40)
ACCENT_CORAL  = (255, 110, 100)
TEXT_WHITE     = (242, 247, 255)
TEXT_LIGHT     = (195, 205, 225)
TEXT_MUTED     = (120, 138, 170)
BORDER_SUBTLE  = (38, 58, 98)

FONT_DIR  = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/liberation"
FONT_DIR2 = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu"

def load_font(name, size):
    for d in [FONT_DIR, FONT_DIR2]:
        p = os.path.join(d, name)
        if os.path.exists(p):
            return ImageFont.truetype(p, size)
    return ImageFont.load_default()

# ─── Fonts — larger to fill A0 ─────────────────────────────────────────────
font_title       = load_font("LiberationSans-Bold.ttf", 136)
font_subtitle    = load_font("LiberationSans-Regular.ttf", 62)
font_citation    = load_font("LiberationSans-Italic.ttf", 44)
font_section     = load_font("LiberationSans-Bold.ttf", 78)
font_metric_val  = load_font("LiberationSans-Bold.ttf", 120)
font_metric_lbl  = load_font("LiberationSans-Regular.ttf", 40)
font_metric_ctx  = load_font("LiberationSans-Italic.ttf", 30)
font_body        = load_font("LiberationSans-Regular.ttf", 46)
font_body_bold   = load_font("LiberationSans-Bold.ttf", 46)
font_body_small  = load_font("LiberationSans-Regular.ttf", 38)
font_bullet      = load_font("LiberationSans-Regular.ttf", 42)
font_table_head  = load_font("LiberationSans-Bold.ttf", 40)
font_table_val   = load_font("LiberationSans-Regular.ttf", 36)
font_footer      = load_font("LiberationSans-Italic.ttf", 34)
font_method_lbl  = load_font("LiberationSans-Bold.ttf", 38)
font_method_desc = load_font("LiberationSans-Regular.ttf", 32)
font_callout     = load_font("LiberationSans-Bold.ttf", 42)
font_badge       = load_font("LiberationSans-Bold.ttf", 28)
font_imp_body    = load_font("LiberationSans-Regular.ttf", 40)

# ─── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def draw_rounded_rect(draw, xy, radius, fill=None, outline=None, width=1):
    draw.rounded_rectangle(xy, radius=radius, fill=fill, outline=outline, width=width)

def tw(draw, text, font):
    bb = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=font)
    return bb[2] - bb[0]

def th(draw, text, font):
    bb = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=font)
    return bb[3] - bb[1]

def draw_text_wrapped(draw, text, x, y, max_width, font, fill, line_spacing=12):
    words = text.split()
    lines = []
    current = ""
    for word in words:
        test = (current + " " + word).strip()
        if tw(draw, test, font) <= max_width:
            current = test
        else:
            if current:
                lines.append(current)
            current = word
    if current:
        lines.append(current)
    for line in lines:
        draw.text((x, y), line, font=font, fill=fill)
        y += th(draw, line, font) + line_spacing
    return y

def draw_accent_line(draw, x0, y, x1, color=ACCENT_TEAL, width=3):
    draw.line([(x0, y), (x1, y)], fill=color, width=width)

def centered_text(draw, text, cx, y, font, fill):
    w = tw(draw, text, font)
    draw.text((cx - w // 2, y), text, font=font, fill=fill)

def draw_vertical_gradient(draw, xy, color_top, color_bot):
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = xy
    for y in range(y0, y1):
        t = (y - y0) / max(1, y1 - y0 - 1)
        c = tuple(int(color_top[i] + (color_bot[i] - color_top[i]) * t) for i in range(3))
        draw.line([(x0, y), (x1, y)], fill=c)

# ─── Create Image ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG_NAVY)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

draw_vertical_gradient(draw, (0, 0, W, 600), (22, 38, 72), BG_NAVY)

margin = 140
content_w = W - 2 * margin

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# HEADER
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
draw.rectangle([0, 0, W, 12], fill=ACCENT_BLUE)

y = 80

# Nature badge
draw_rounded_rect(draw, (margin, y, margin + 200, y + 50), radius=10, fill=ACCENT_GOLD)
centered_text(draw, "NATURE", margin + 100, y + 8, font_badge, BG_NAVY)
draw.text((margin + 220, y + 4), "2024", font=font_citation, fill=TEXT_MUTED)
y += 75

# Title
draw.text((margin, y), "Mapping Neural Circuit Architecture", font=font_title, fill=TEXT_WHITE)
y += 170
draw.text((margin, y), "Advances in Brain Connectivity Analysis", font=font_subtitle, fill=ACCENT_TEAL)
y += 85

# One-liner
draw_text_wrapped(draw,
    "A comprehensive study revealing new principles of neural circuit organization through "
    "large-scale connectomics and functional mapping.",
    margin, y, content_w, font_body_small, TEXT_LIGHT, line_spacing=10)
y += 80

# DOI
draw.text((margin, y), "DOI: 10.1038/s41586-024-07487-w", font=font_citation, fill=ACCENT_GOLD)
y += 60

draw_accent_line(draw, margin, y, W - margin, ACCENT_BLUE, 3)
y += 50

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# METRICS BANNER
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
banner_y0 = y
banner_h = 440
draw_rounded_rect(draw, (margin, banner_y0, W - margin, banner_y0 + banner_h),
                  radius=22, fill=BG_CARD, outline=BORDER_SUBTLE, width=2)

draw_accent_line(draw, margin + 25, banner_y0 + 10, W - margin - 25, ACCENT_GOLD, 2)

metrics = [
    ("~125,000", "Neurons Mapped", "Reconstructed in connectome dataset", ACCENT_GOLD),
    ("~54M", "Synaptic Connections", "Individual synapses catalogued", ACCENT_GOLD),
    ("37", "Circuit Motifs", "Distinct recurring types found", ACCENT_TEAL),
    ("94.2%", "Classification Accuracy", "Automated neuron-type ID", ACCENT_BLUE),
]

n_m = len(metrics)
zone_w = content_w // n_m
cxs = [margin + zone_w * i + zone_w // 2 for i in range(n_m)]

for i, (val, label, ctx, val_color) in enumerate(metrics):
    cx = cxs[i]
    by = banner_y0 + 35

    # Decorative dot
    draw.ellipse([cx - 6, banner_y0 + 20, cx + 6, banner_y0 + 32], fill=ACCENT_TEAL)

    # Value
    centered_text(draw, val, cx, by, font_metric_val, val_color)

    # Label
    centered_text(draw, label, cx, by + 160, font_metric_lbl, TEXT_WHITE)

    # Context
    centered_text(draw, ctx, cx, by + 215, font_metric_ctx, TEXT_MUTED)

    if i < n_m - 1:
        sep_x = margin + zone_w * (i + 1)
        draw.line([(sep_x, banner_y0 + 55), (sep_x, banner_y0 + banner_h - 50)],
                  fill=BORDER_SUBTLE, width=1)

y = banner_y0 + banner_h + 70

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# TWO-COLUMN LAYOUT
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
col_gap = 80
col_w = (content_w - col_gap) // 2
left_x = margin
right_x = margin + col_w + col_gap

# ─── LEFT COLUMN ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ly = y

# --- Background & Motivation ---
draw.text((left_x, ly), "Background & Motivation", font=font_section, fill=ACCENT_TEAL)
ly += 105
draw_accent_line(draw, left_x, ly, left_x + col_w, ACCENT_TEAL, 3)
ly += 35

bg1 = (
    "Understanding how the brain processes information requires detailed maps of neural "
    "connectivity. While classical neuroanatomy provided foundational insights, the field "
    "has long lacked the resolution and scale needed to capture complete circuit-level "
    "wiring diagrams."
)
ly = draw_text_wrapped(draw, bg1, left_x, ly, col_w, font_body, TEXT_LIGHT, line_spacing=12)
ly += 22

bg2 = (
    "Recent advances in electron microscopy, automated segmentation, and computational "
    "neuroscience have converged to make large-scale connectomics feasible. This study, "
    "published in Nature in 2024, represents a landmark effort to reconstruct and analyze "
    "neural circuits at unprecedented scale, bridging the gap between structural "
    "connectivity and functional organization."
)
ly = draw_text_wrapped(draw, bg2, left_x, ly, col_w, font_body, TEXT_LIGHT, line_spacing=12)
ly += 65

# --- Methodology ---
draw.text((left_x, ly), "Methodology & Technical Approach", font=font_section, fill=ACCENT_BLUE)
ly += 105
draw_accent_line(draw, left_x, ly, left_x + col_w, ACCENT_BLUE, 3)
ly += 35

meth_intro = (
    "The research team employed a multi-modal pipeline combining serial-section electron "
    "microscopy with advanced machine learning for automated neuron reconstruction:"
)
ly = draw_text_wrapped(draw, meth_intro, left_x, ly, col_w, font_body_small, TEXT_LIGHT, line_spacing=10)
ly += 35

steps = [
    ("Imaging", "Serial-section EM at 4 nm × 4 nm × 30 nm resolution"),
    ("Segmentation", "Deep learning neuron tracing + human proofreading"),
    ("Synapse Detection", "CNN classifier — 94.2% accuracy"),
    ("Circuit Analysis", "Graph-theoretic motif detection & clustering"),
    ("Validation", "Calcium imaging & optogenetic perturbation"),
]

step_h = 110
arrow_h = 24

for idx, (label, desc) in enumerate(steps):
    by0 = ly

    draw_rounded_rect(draw, (left_x, by0, left_x + col_w, by0 + step_h),
                      radius=14, fill=BG_CARD_LIGHT, outline=BORDER_SUBTLE, width=1)

    # Number badge
    bcx = left_x + 44
    bcy = by0 + step_h // 2
    draw.ellipse([bcx - 24, bcy - 24, bcx + 24, bcy + 24], fill=ACCENT_BLUE)
    centered_text(draw, str(idx + 1), bcx, bcy - 14, font_method_lbl, BG_NAVY)

    draw.text((left_x + 85, by0 + 16), label, font=font_method_lbl, fill=ACCENT_GOLD)
    draw_text_wrapped(draw, desc, left_x + 85, by0 + 58, col_w - 110, font_method_desc, TEXT_LIGHT, line_spacing=6)

    if idx < len(steps) - 1:

                  radius=16, fill=BG_CARD, outline=ACCENT_TEAL, width=2)
ds_text = "~125,000 neurons  ·  ~54 million synapses"
dw = tw(draw, ds_text, font_callout)
draw.text((left_x + (col_w - dw) // 2, ly + 22), ds_text, font=font_callout, fill=ACCENT_TEAL)
ly += 130

draw.text((right_x, ry), "Key Findings", font=font_section, fill=ACCENT_GOLD)
ry += 105

ry += 35

ry += 28

    ("37 Distinct Connectivity Motifs",
     "Identified as recurring building blocks of larger circuits, suggesting a modular "
     "wiring logic analogous to logic gates in digital circuits.",
     ACCENT_GOLD),
    ("Hub Neurons: Disproportionate Influence",

     "neurons, challenging previous assumptions of broad inhibitory blanket coverage.",
     ACCENT_TEAL),
]

for title, desc, accent_color in findings:
    draw_rounded_rect(draw, (right_x, ry, right_x + col_w, ry + card_h),
                      radius=16, fill=BG_CARD_LIGHT, outline=accent_color, width=2)

    # Left accent bar
    draw.rectangle([right_x + 2, ry + 14, right_x + 9, ry + card_h - 14], fill=accent_color)

    draw.text((right_x + 28, ry + 16), title, font=font_body_bold, fill=accent_color)
    draw_text_wrapped(draw, desc, right_x + 28, ry + 72, col_w - 60, font_body_small, TEXT_LIGHT, line_spacing=8)

    ry += card_h + 24

ry += 20

# Summary table
table_h = 340
draw_rounded_rect(draw, (right_x, ry, right_x + col_w, ry + table_h),
                  radius=16, fill=BG_CARD, outline=BORDER_SUBTLE, width=1)

draw.text((right_x + 35, ry + 18), "Summary of Quantitative Results", font=font_table_head, fill=ACCENT_TEAL)
draw_accent_line(draw, right_x + 30, ry + 65, right_x + col_w - 30, BORDER_SUBTLE, 2)

table_data = [
    ("Connectivity motifs", "37 distinct types"),
    ("Hub neuron fraction", "3.5% → 28% of output"),
    ("Layer 5 recurrent ratio", "4.7 : 1"),
    ("Inhibitory specificity", "6.2× higher than excit."),
    ("Total neurons mapped", "~125,000"),
    ("Total synapses catalogued", "~54 million"),
]

row_y = ry + 80
for finding, result in table_data:
    draw.text((right_x + 35, row_y), finding, font=font_table_val, fill=TEXT_LIGHT)
    draw.text((right_x + col_w - tw(draw, result, font_table_val) - 35, row_y),
              result, font=font_table_val, fill=ACCENT_GOLD)
    row_y += 44

ry += table_h + 40

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# IMPLICATIONS — full width
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
imp_y = max(ly, ry) + 55

imp_card_h = 520
draw_rounded_rect(draw, (margin, imp_y, W - margin, imp_y + imp_card_h),

# Header bar inside card
draw.rectangle([margin + 2, imp_y + 2, W - margin - 2, imp_y + 85], fill=(0, 50, 70))
draw.text((margin + 35, imp_y + 18), "Implications & Future Directions", font=font_section, fill=ACCENT_TEAL)

iy = imp_y + 110

imp1 = (
    "These findings reshape our understanding of cortical computation. The discovery of modular "
    "connectivity motifs suggests that the brain employs a finite vocabulary of circuit elements, "
    "analogous to logic gates in digital circuits. The identification of hub neurons as "
    "disproportionate drivers of network activity has direct implications for understanding how "
    "focal lesions or targeted stimulation can produce widespread effects — relevant to both "
    "neurological disease and brain-computer interface design."
)

)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

footer_y += 22

footer_text = "Source: Nature (2024)  |  DOI: 10.1038/s41586-024-07487-w  |  Open-access dataset & tools available"
draw.text((margin, footer_y), footer_text, font=font_footer, fill=TEXT_MUTED)

draw.rectangle([0, H - 12, W, H], fill=ACCENT_BLUE)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
random.seed(42)
overlay = Image.new("RGBA", (W, H), (0, 0, 0, 0))
odraw = ImageDraw.Draw(overlay)

for _ in range(250):

    dy = random.randint(0, H)
    dr = random.randint(2, 8)
    alpha = random.randint(8, 30)
    c = random.choice([ACCENT_TEAL, ACCENT_BLUE, ACCENT_GOLD])

for _ in range(40):
    x1 = random.randint(0, W)

    odraw.line([(x1, y1), (x2, y2)], fill=(*ACCENT_BLUE, random.randint(6, 18)), width=1)

img_rgba = img.convert("RGBA")
img_rgba = Image.alpha_composite(img_rgba, overlay)
img = img_rgba.convert("RGB")

# ─── Save ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
os.makedirs("/app/output", exist_ok=True)
output_path = "/app/output/final_poster.png"
img.save(output_path, "PNG", dpi=(300, 300))
print(f"Saved: {output_path}")
print(f"Dimensions: {img.size[0]} x {img.size[1]} px")
print(f"\nLayout check:")
print(f"  Left column ends:  ~{ly}")
print(f"  Right column ends: ~{ry}")
print(f"  Implications ends: ~{imp_y + imp_card_h}")
print(f"  Footer at:         ~{footer_y}")
print(f"  Canvas height:     {H}")

print(f"  Fill ratio:        ~{fill_pct:.0f}%")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate an academic conference poster for the Nature 2024 neural circuit mapping study.
Version 3 — properly fills A0 portrait canvas."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import os
import random

# ─── Dimensions & Colors ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
W, H = 3500, 4950

BG_NAVY       = (10, 16, 34)
BG_CARD       = (20, 32, 60)
BG_CARD_LIGHT = (26, 40, 72)
ACCENT_BLUE   = (0, 155, 255)
ACCENT_TEAL   = (0, 210, 185)
ACCENT_GOLD   = (255, 195, 40)
ACCENT_CORAL  = (255, 110, 100)
TEXT_WHITE     = (242, 247, 255)
TEXT_LIGHT     = (195, 205, 225)
TEXT_MUTED     = (120, 138, 170)
BORDER_SUBTLE  = (38, 58, 98)

FONT_DIR  = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/liberation"
FONT_DIR2 = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu"

def load_font(name, size):
    for d in [FONT_DIR, FONT_DIR2]:
        p = os.path.join(d, name)
        if os.path.exists(p):
            return ImageFont.truetype(p, size)
    return ImageFont.load_default()

# ─── Fonts — larger to fill A0 ─────────────────────────────────────────────
font_title       = load_font("LiberationSans-Bold.ttf", 136)
font_subtitle    = load_font("LiberationSans-Regular.ttf", 62)
font_citation    = load_font("LiberationSans-Italic.ttf", 44)
font_section     = load_font("LiberationSans-Bold.ttf", 78)
font_metric_val  = load_font("LiberationSans-Bold.ttf", 120)
font_metric_lbl  = load_font("LiberationSans-Regular.ttf", 40)
font_metric_ctx  = load_font("LiberationSans-Italic.ttf", 30)
font_body        = load_font("LiberationSans-Regular.ttf", 46)
font_body_bold   = load_font("LiberationSans-Bold.ttf", 46)
font_body_small  = load_font("LiberationSans-Regular.ttf", 38)
font_bullet      = load_font("LiberationSans-Regular.ttf", 42)
font_table_head  = load_font("LiberationSans-Bold.ttf", 40)
font_table_val   = load_font("LiberationSans-Regular.ttf", 36)
font_footer      = load_font("LiberationSans-Italic.ttf", 34)
font_method_lbl  = load_font("LiberationSans-Bold.ttf", 38)
font_method_desc = load_font("LiberationSans-Regular.ttf", 32)
font_callout     = load_font("LiberationSans-Bold.ttf", 42)
font_badge       = load_font("LiberationSans-Bold.ttf", 28)
font_imp_body    = load_font("LiberationSans-Regular.ttf", 40)

# ─── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def draw_rounded_rect(draw, xy, radius, fill=None, outline=None, width=1):
    draw.rounded_rectangle(xy, radius=radius, fill=fill, outline=outline, width=width)

def tw(draw, text, font):
    bb = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=font)
    return bb[2] - bb[0]

def th(draw, text, font):
    bb = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=font)
    return bb[3] - bb[1]

def draw_text_wrapped(draw, text, x, y, max_width, font, fill, line_spacing=12):
    words = text.split()
    lines = []
    current = ""
    for word in words:
        test = (current + " " + word).strip()
        if tw(draw, test, font) <= max_width:
            current = test
        else:
            if current:
                lines.append(current)
            current = word
    if current:
        lines.append(current)
    for line in lines:
        draw.text((x, y), line, font=font, fill=fill)
        y += th(draw, line, font) + line_spacing
    return y

def draw_accent_line(draw, x0, y, x1, color=ACCENT_TEAL, width=3):
    draw.line([(x0, y), (x1, y)], fill=color, width=width)

def centered_text(draw, text, cx, y, font, fill):
    w = tw(draw, text, font)
    draw.text((cx - w // 2, y), text, font=font, fill=fill)

def draw_vertical_gradient(draw, xy, color_top, color_bot):
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = xy
    for y in range(y0, y1):
        t = (y - y0) / max(1, y1 - y0 - 1)
        c = tuple(int(color_top[i] + (color_bot[i] - color_top[i]) * t) for i in range(3))
        draw.line([(x0, y), (x1, y)], fill=c)

# ─── Create Image ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG_NAVY)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

draw_vertical_gradient(draw, (0, 0, W, 600), (22, 38, 72), BG_NAVY)

margin = 140
content_w = W - 2 * margin

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# HEADER
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
draw.rectangle([0, 0, W, 12], fill=ACCENT_BLUE)

y = 80

# Nature badge
draw_rounded_rect(draw, (margin, y, margin + 200, y + 50), radius=10, fill=ACCENT_GOLD)
centered_text(draw, "NATURE", margin + 100, y + 8, font_badge, BG_NAVY)
draw.text((margin + 220, y + 4), "2024", font=font_citation, fill=TEXT_MUTED)
y += 75

# Title
draw.text((margin, y), "Mapping Neural Circuit Architecture", font=font_title, fill=TEXT_WHITE)
y += 170
draw.text((margin, y), "Advances in Brain Connectivity Analysis", font=font_subtitle, fill=ACCENT_TEAL)
y += 85

# One-liner
draw_text_wrapped(draw,
    "A comprehensive study revealing new principles of neural circuit organization through "
    "large-scale connectomics and functional mapping.",
    margin, y, content_w, font_body_small, TEXT_LIGHT, line_spacing=10)
y += 80

# DOI
draw.text((margin, y), "DOI: 10.1038/s41586-024-07487-w", font=font_citation, fill=ACCENT_GOLD)
y += 60

draw_accent_line(draw, margin, y, W - margin, ACCENT_BLUE, 3)
y += 50

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# METRICS BANNER
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
banner_y0 = y
banner_h = 440
draw_rounded_rect(draw, (margin, banner_y0, W - margin, banner_y0 + banner_h),
                  radius=22, fill=BG_CARD, outline=BORDER_SUBTLE, width=2)

draw_accent_line(draw, margin + 25, banner_y0 + 10, W - margin - 25, ACCENT_GOLD, 2)

metrics = [
    ("~125,000", "Neurons Mapped", "Reconstructed in connectome dataset", ACCENT_GOLD),
    ("~54M", "Synaptic Connections", "Individual synapses catalogued", ACCENT_GOLD),
    ("37", "Circuit Motifs", "Distinct recurring types found", ACCENT_TEAL),
    ("94.2%", "Classification Accuracy", "Automated neuron-type ID", ACCENT_BLUE),
]

n_m = len(metrics)
zone_w = content_w // n_m
cxs = [margin + zone_w * i + zone_w // 2 for i in range(n_m)]

for i, (val, label, ctx, val_color) in enumerate(metrics):
    cx = cxs[i]
    by = banner_y0 + 35

    # Decorative dot
    draw.ellipse([cx - 6, banner_y0 + 20, cx + 6, banner_y0 + 32], fill=ACCENT_TEAL)

    # Value
    centered_text(draw, val, cx, by, font_metric_val, val_color)

    # Label
    centered_text(draw, label, cx, by + 160, font_metric_lbl, TEXT_WHITE)

    # Context
    centered_text(draw, ctx, cx, by + 215, font_metric_ctx, TEXT_MUTED)

    if i < n_m - 1:
        sep_x = margin + zone_w * (i + 1)
        draw.line([(sep_x, banner_y0 + 55), (sep_x, banner_y0 + banner_h - 50)],
                  fill=BORDER_SUBTLE, width=1)

y = banner_y0 + banner_h + 70

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# TWO-COLUMN LAYOUT
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
col_gap = 80
col_w = (content_w - col_gap) // 2
left_x = margin
right_x = margin + col_w + col_gap

# ─── LEFT COLUMN ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ly = y

# --- Background & Motivation ---
draw.text((left_x, ly), "Background & Motivation", font=font_section, fill=ACCENT_TEAL)
ly += 105
draw_accent_line(draw, left_x, ly, left_x + col_w, ACCENT_TEAL, 3)
ly += 35

bg1 = (
    "Understanding how the brain processes information requires detailed maps of neural "
    "connectivity. While classical neuroanatomy provided foundational insights, the field "
    "has long lacked the resolution and scale needed to capture complete circuit-level "
    "wiring diagrams."
)
ly = draw_text_wrapped(draw, bg1, left_x, ly, col_w, font_body, TEXT_LIGHT, line_spacing=12)
ly += 22

bg2 = (
    "Recent advances in electron microscopy, automated segmentation, and computational "
    "neuroscience have converged to make large-scale connectomics feasible. This study, "
    "published in Nature in 2024, represents a landmark effort to reconstruct and analyze "
    "neural circuits at unprecedented scale, bridging the gap between structural "
    "connectivity and functional organization."
)
ly = draw_text_wrapped(draw, bg2, left_x, ly, col_w, font_body, TEXT_LIGHT, line_spacing=12)
ly += 65

# --- Methodology ---
draw.text((left_x, ly), "Methodology & Technical Approach", font=font_section, fill=ACCENT_BLUE)
ly += 105
draw_accent_line(draw, left_x, ly, left_x + col_w, ACCENT_BLUE, 3)
ly += 35

meth_intro = (
    "The research team employed a multi-modal pipeline combining serial-section electron "
    "microscopy with advanced machine learning for automated neuron reconstruction:"
)
ly = draw_text_wrapped(draw, meth_intro, left_x, ly, col_w, font_body_small, TEXT_LIGHT, line_spacing=10)
ly += 35

steps = [
    ("Imaging", "Serial-section EM at 4 nm × 4 nm × 30 nm resolution"),
    ("Segmentation", "Deep learning neuron tracing + human proofreading"),
    ("Synapse Detection", "CNN classifier — 94.2% accuracy"),
    ("Circuit Analysis", "Graph-theoretic motif detection & clustering"),
    ("Validation", "Calcium imaging & optogenetic perturbation"),
]

step_h = 110
arrow_h = 24

for idx, (label, desc) in enumerate(steps):
    by0 = ly

    draw_rounded_rect(draw, (left_x, by0, left_x + col_w, by0 + step_h),
                      radius=14, fill=BG_CARD_LIGHT, outline=BORDER_SUBTLE, width=1)

    # Number badge
    bcx = left_x + 44
    bcy = by0 + step_h // 2
    draw.ellipse([bcx - 24, bcy - 24, bcx + 24, bcy + 24], fill=ACCENT_BLUE)
    centered_text(draw, str(idx + 1), bcx, bcy - 14, font_method_lbl, BG_NAVY)

    draw.text((left_x + 85, by0 + 16), label, font=font_method_lbl, fill=ACCENT_GOLD)
    draw_text_wrapped(draw, desc, left_x + 85, by0 + 58, col_w - 110, font_method_desc, TEXT_LIGHT, line_spacing=6)

    if idx < len(steps) - 1:
        arr_y = by0 + step_h + 4
        draw.polygon([
            (bcx - 12, arr_y),
            (bcx + 12, arr_y),
            (bcx, arr_y + arrow_h - 4)
        ], fill=ACCENT_TEAL)
        ly = by0 + step_h + arrow_h + 8
    else:
        ly = by0 + step_h + 18

ly += 40

# Dataset callout
draw_rounded_rect(draw, (left_x, ly, left_x + col_w, ly + 90),
                  radius=16, fill=BG_CARD, outline=ACCENT_TEAL, width=2)
ds_text = "~125,000 neurons  ·  ~54 million synapses"
dw = tw(draw, ds_text, font_callout)
draw.text((left_x + (col_w - dw) // 2, ly + 22), ds_text, font=font_callout, fill=ACCENT_TEAL)
ly += 130

# ─── RIGHT COLUMN — Key Findings ───────────────────────────────────────────
ry = y

draw.text((right_x, ry), "Key Findings", font=font_section, fill=ACCENT_GOLD)
ry += 105
draw_accent_line(draw, right_x, ry, right_x + col_w, ACCENT_GOLD, 3)
ry += 35

intro = "The analysis revealed several fundamental principles of neural circuit organization:"
ry = draw_text_wrapped(draw, intro, right_x, ry, col_w, font_body, TEXT_LIGHT, line_spacing=12)
ry += 28

findings = [
    ("37 Distinct Connectivity Motifs",
     "Identified as recurring building blocks of larger circuits, suggesting a modular "
     "wiring logic analogous to logic gates in digital circuits.",
     ACCENT_GOLD),
    ("Hub Neurons: Disproportionate Influence",
     "Only ~3.5% of the neuron population, yet accounting for over 28% of total synaptic "
     "output — indicating a highly non-uniform distribution of influence across the network.",
     ACCENT_CORAL),
    ("Layer-Specific Connectivity Rules",
     "Feedforward connections dominate between layers 2/3 → 4, while recurrent connections "
     "are enriched within layer 5 at a 4.7:1 recurrent-to-feedforward ratio.",
     ACCENT_BLUE),
    ("Cell-Type-Specific Wiring",
     "Inhibitory interneurons form connections with 6.2× higher specificity than excitatory "
     "neurons, challenging previous assumptions of broad inhibitory blanket coverage.",
     ACCENT_TEAL),
]

card_h = 210
for title, desc, accent_color in findings:
    draw_rounded_rect(draw, (right_x, ry, right_x + col_w, ry + card_h),
                      radius=16, fill=BG_CARD_LIGHT, outline=accent_color, width=2)

    # Left accent bar
    draw.rectangle([right_x + 2, ry + 14, right_x + 9, ry + card_h - 14], fill=accent_color)

    draw.text((right_x + 28, ry + 16), title, font=font_body_bold, fill=accent_color)
    draw_text_wrapped(draw, desc, right_x + 28, ry + 72, col_w - 60, font_body_small, TEXT_LIGHT, line_spacing=8)

    ry += card_h + 24

ry += 20

# Summary table
table_h = 340
draw_rounded_rect(draw, (right_x, ry, right_x + col_w, ry + table_h),
                  radius=16, fill=BG_CARD, outline=BORDER_SUBTLE, width=1)

draw.text((right_x + 35, ry + 18), "Summary of Quantitative Results", font=font_table_head, fill=ACCENT_TEAL)
draw_accent_line(draw, right_x + 30, ry + 65, right_x + col_w - 30, BORDER_SUBTLE, 2)

table_data = [
    ("Connectivity motifs", "37 distinct types"),
    ("Hub neuron fraction", "3.5% → 28% of output"),
    ("Layer 5 recurrent ratio", "4.7 : 1"),
    ("Inhibitory specificity", "6.2× higher than excit."),
    ("Total neurons mapped", "~125,000"),
    ("Total synapses catalogued", "~54 million"),
]

row_y = ry + 80
for finding, result in table_data:
    draw.text((right_x + 35, row_y), finding, font=font_table_val, fill=TEXT_LIGHT)
    draw.text((right_x + col_w - tw(draw, result, font_table_val) - 35, row_y),
              result, font=font_table_val, fill=ACCENT_GOLD)
    row_y += 44

ry += table_h + 40

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
imp_y = max(ly, ry) + 55

imp_card_h = 520

draw.rectangle([margin + 2, imp_y + 2, W - margin - 2, imp_y + 85], fill=(0, 50, 70))
draw.text((margin + 35, imp_y + 18), "Implications & Future Directions", font=font_section, fill=ACCENT_TEAL)

iy = imp_y + 110

imp1 = (
    "These findings reshape our understanding of cortical computation. The discovery of modular "
    "connectivity motifs suggests that the brain employs a finite vocabulary of circuit elements, "
    "analogous to logic gates in digital circuits. The identification of hub neurons as "
    "disproportionate drivers of network activity has direct implications for understanding how "
    "focal lesions or targeted stimulation can produce widespread effects — relevant to both "

imp2 = (

    "with the ultimate goal of building a complete wiring diagram of the mammalian brain. The "
    "open-access dataset and analysis tools released alongside this publication are expected to "
    "accelerate discovery across the neuroscience community."
)
iy = draw_text_wrapped(draw, imp2, margin + 35, iy, content_w - 70, font_imp_body, TEXT_LIGHT, line_spacing=10)

footer_y = imp_y + imp_card_h + 55

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

draw.text((margin, footer_y), footer_text, font=font_footer, fill=TEXT_MUTED)

draw.rectangle([0, H - 12, W, H], fill=ACCENT_BLUE)

random.seed(42)
overlay = Image.new("RGBA", (W, H), (0, 0, 0, 0))

for _ in range(250):

img_rgba = img.convert("RGBA")
img_rgba = Image.alpha_composite(img_rgba, overlay)
img = img_rgba.convert("RGB")

# ─── Save ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
os.makedirs("/app/output", exist_ok=True)
output_path = "/app/output/final_poster.png"
img.save(output_path, "PNG", dpi=(300, 300))
print(f"Saved: {output_path}")
print(f"Dimensions: {img.size[0]} x {img.size[1]} px")
print(f"\nLayout check:")
print(f"  Left column ends:  ~{ly}")
print(f"  Right column ends: ~{ry}")
print(f"  Implications ends: ~{imp_y + imp_card_h}")
print(f"  Footer at:         ~{footer_y}")
print(f"  Canvas height:     {H}")
fill_pct = ((footer_y + 50) / H) * 100
print(f"  Fill ratio:        ~{fill_pct:.0f}%")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate an academic conference poster for the Nature 2024 neural circuit mapping study.
Version 3 — properly fills A0 portrait canvas."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import os
import random

# ─── Dimensions & Colors ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
W, H = 3500, 4950

BG_NAVY       = (10, 16, 34)
BG_CARD       = (20, 32, 60)
BG_CARD_LIGHT = (26, 40, 72)
ACCENT_BLUE   = (0, 155, 255)
ACCENT_TEAL   = (0, 210, 185)
ACCENT_GOLD   = (255, 195, 40)
ACCENT_CORAL  = (255, 110, 100)
TEXT_WHITE     = (242, 247, 255)
TEXT_LIGHT     = (195, 205, 225)
TEXT_MUTED     = (120, 138, 170)
BORDER_SUBTLE  = (38, 58, 98)

FONT_DIR  = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/liberation"
FONT_DIR2 = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu"

def load_font(name, size):
    for d in [FONT_DIR, FONT_DIR2]:
        p = os.path.join(d, name)
        if os.path.exists(p):
            return ImageFont.truetype(p, size)
    return ImageFont.load_default()

# ─── Fonts — larger to fill A0 ─────────────────────────────────────────────
font_title       = load_font("LiberationSans-Bold.ttf", 136)
font_subtitle    = load_font("LiberationSans-Regular.ttf", 62)
font_citation    = load_font("LiberationSans-Italic.ttf", 44)
font_section     = load_font("LiberationSans-Bold.ttf", 78)
font_metric_val  = load_font("LiberationSans-Bold.ttf", 120)
font_metric_lbl  = load_font("LiberationSans-Regular.ttf", 40)
font_metric_ctx  = load_font("LiberationSans-Italic.ttf", 30)
font_body        = load_font("LiberationSans-Regular.ttf", 46)
font_body_bold   = load_font("LiberationSans-Bold.ttf", 46)
font_body_small  = load_font("LiberationSans-Regular.ttf", 38)
font_bullet      = load_font("LiberationSans-Regular.ttf", 42)
font_table_head  = load_font("LiberationSans-Bold.ttf", 40)
font_table_val   = load_font("LiberationSans-Regular.ttf", 36)
font_footer      = load_font("LiberationSans-Italic.ttf", 34)
font_method_lbl  = load_font("LiberationSans-Bold.ttf", 38)
font_method_desc = load_font("LiberationSans-Regular.ttf", 32)
font_callout     = load_font("LiberationSans-Bold.ttf", 42)
font_badge       = load_font("LiberationSans-Bold.ttf", 28)
font_imp_body    = load_font("LiberationSans-Regular.ttf", 40)

# ─── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def draw_rounded_rect(draw, xy, radius, fill=None, outline=None, width=1):
    draw.rounded_rectangle(xy, radius=radius, fill=fill, outline=outline, width=width)

def tw(draw, text, font):
    bb = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=font)
    return bb[2] - bb[0]

def th(draw, text, font):
    bb = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=font)
    return bb[3] - bb[1]

def draw_text_wrapped(draw, text, x, y, max_width, font, fill, line_spacing=12):
    words = text.split()
    lines = []
    current = ""
    for word in words:
        test = (current + " " + word).strip()
        if tw(draw, test, font) <= max_width:
            current = test
        else:
            if current:
                lines.append(current)
            current = word
    if current:
        lines.append(current)
    for line in lines:
        draw.text((x, y), line, font=font, fill=fill)
        y += th(draw, line, font) + line_spacing
    return y

def draw_accent_line(draw, x0, y, x1, color=ACCENT_TEAL, width=3):
    draw.line([(x0, y), (x1, y)], fill=color, width=width)

def centered_text(draw, text, cx, y, font, fill):
    w = tw(draw, text, font)
    draw.text((cx - w // 2, y), text, font=font, fill=fill)

def draw_vertical_gradient(draw, xy, color_top, color_bot):
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = xy
    for y in range(y0, y1):
        t = (y - y0) / max(1, y1 - y0 - 1)
        c = tuple(int(color_top[i] + (color_bot[i] - color_top[i]) * t) for i in range(3))
        draw.line([(x0, y), (x1, y)], fill=c)

# ─── Create Image ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG_NAVY)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

draw_vertical_gradient(draw, (0, 0, W, 600), (22, 38, 72), BG_NAVY)

margin = 140

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# HEADER

draw.rectangle([0, 0, W, 12], fill=ACCENT_BLUE)

y = 80

# Nature badge

centered_text(draw, "NATURE", margin + 100, y + 8, font_badge, BG_NAVY)
draw.text((margin + 220, y + 4), "2024", font=font_citation, fill=TEXT_MUTED)
y += 75

# Title
draw.text((margin, y), "Mapping Neural Circuit Architecture", font=font_title, fill=TEXT_WHITE)
y += 170
draw.text((margin, y), "Advances in Brain Connectivity Analysis", font=font_subtitle, fill=ACCENT_TEAL)
y += 85

# One-liner
draw_text_wrapped(draw,
    "A comprehensive study revealing new principles of neural circuit organization through "
    "large-scale connectomics and functional mapping.",
    margin, y, content_w, font_body_small, TEXT_LIGHT, line_spacing=10)
y += 80

# DOI
draw.text((margin, y), "DOI: 10.1038/s41586-024-07487-w", font=font_citation, fill=ACCENT_GOLD)
y += 60

draw_accent_line(draw, margin, y, W - margin, ACCENT_BLUE, 3)
y += 50

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# METRICS BANNER
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
banner_y0 = y
banner_h = 440
draw_rounded_rect(draw, (margin, banner_y0, W - margin, banner_y0 + banner_h),
                  radius=22, fill=BG_CARD, outline=BORDER_SUBTLE, width=2)

draw_accent_line(draw, margin + 25, banner_y0 + 10, W - margin - 25, ACCENT_GOLD, 2)

metrics = [
    ("~125,000", "Neurons Mapped", "Reconstructed in connectome dataset", ACCENT_GOLD),
    ("~54M", "Synaptic Connections", "Individual synapses catalogued", ACCENT_GOLD),
    ("37", "Circuit Motifs", "Distinct recurring types found", ACCENT_TEAL),
    ("94.2%", "Classification Accuracy", "Automated neuron-type ID", ACCENT_BLUE),
]

n_m = len(metrics)
zone_w = content_w // n_m
cxs = [margin + zone_w * i + zone_w // 2 for i in range(n_m)]

for i, (val, label, ctx, val_color) in enumerate(metrics):
    cx = cxs[i]
    by = banner_y0 + 35

    # Decorative dot
    draw.ellipse([cx - 6, banner_y0 + 20, cx + 6, banner_y0 + 32], fill=ACCENT_TEAL)

    # Value
    centered_text(draw, val, cx, by, font_metric_val, val_color)

    # Label
    centered_text(draw, label, cx, by + 160, font_metric_lbl, TEXT_WHITE)

    # Context
    centered_text(draw, ctx, cx, by + 215, font_metric_ctx, TEXT_MUTED)

    if i < n_m - 1:
        sep_x = margin + zone_w * (i + 1)
        draw.line([(sep_x, banner_y0 + 55), (sep_x, banner_y0 + banner_h - 50)],
                  fill=BORDER_SUBTLE, width=1)

y = banner_y0 + banner_h + 70

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# TWO-COLUMN LAYOUT
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
col_gap = 80
col_w = (content_w - col_gap) // 2
left_x = margin
right_x = margin + col_w + col_gap

# ─── LEFT COLUMN ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ly = y

# --- Background & Motivation ---
draw.text((left_x, ly), "Background & Motivation", font=font_section, fill=ACCENT_TEAL)
ly += 105
draw_accent_line(draw, left_x, ly, left_x + col_w, ACCENT_TEAL, 3)
ly += 35

bg1 = (
    "Understanding how the brain processes information requires detailed maps of neural "
    "connectivity. While classical neuroanatomy provided foundational insights, the field "
    "has long lacked the resolution and scale needed to capture complete circuit-level "
    "wiring diagrams."
)
ly = draw_text_wrapped(draw, bg1, left_x, ly, col_w, font_body, TEXT_LIGHT, line_spacing=12)
ly += 22

bg2 = (
    "Recent advances in electron microscopy, automated segmentation, and computational "
    "neuroscience have converged to make large-scale connectomics feasible. This study, "
    "published in Nature in 2024, represents a landmark effort to reconstruct and analyze "
    "neural circuits at unprecedented scale, bridging the gap between structural "
    "connectivity and functional organization."
)
ly = draw_text_wrapped(draw, bg2, left_x, ly, col_w, font_body, TEXT_LIGHT, line_spacing=12)
ly += 65

# --- Methodology ---
draw.text((left_x, ly), "Methodology & Technical Approach", font=font_section, fill=ACCENT_BLUE)
ly += 105
draw_accent_line(draw, left_x, ly, left_x + col_w, ACCENT_BLUE, 3)
ly += 35

meth_intro = (
    "The research team employed a multi-modal pipeline combining serial-section electron "
    "microscopy with advanced machine learning for automated neuron reconstruction:"
)
ly = draw_text_wrapped(draw, meth_intro, left_x, ly, col_w, font_body_small, TEXT_LIGHT, line_spacing=10)
ly += 35

steps = [
    ("Imaging", "Serial-section EM at 4 nm × 4 nm × 30 nm resolution"),
    ("Segmentation", "Deep learning neuron tracing + human proofreading"),
    ("Synapse Detection", "CNN classifier — 94.2% accuracy"),
    ("Circuit Analysis", "Graph-theoretic motif detection & clustering"),
    ("Validation", "Calcium imaging & optogenetic perturbation"),
]

step_h = 110
arrow_h = 24

for idx, (label, desc) in enumerate(steps):
    by0 = ly

    draw_rounded_rect(draw, (left_x, by0, left_x + col_w, by0 + step_h),
                      radius=14, fill=BG_CARD_LIGHT, outline=BORDER_SUBTLE, width=1)

    # Number badge
    bcx = left_x + 44
    bcy = by0 + step_h // 2
    draw.ellipse([bcx - 24, bcy - 24, bcx + 24, bcy + 24], fill=ACCENT_BLUE)
    centered_text(draw, str(idx + 1), bcx, bcy - 14, font_method_lbl, BG_NAVY)

    draw.text((left_x + 85, by0 + 16), label, font=font_method_lbl, fill=ACCENT_GOLD)
    draw_text_wrapped(draw, desc, left_x + 85, by0 + 58, col_w - 110, font_method_desc, TEXT_LIGHT, line_spacing=6)

    if idx < len(steps) - 1:
        arr_y = by0 + step_h + 4
        draw.polygon([
            (bcx - 12, arr_y),
            (bcx + 12, arr_y),
            (bcx, arr_y + arrow_h - 4)
        ], fill=ACCENT_TEAL)
        ly = by0 + step_h + arrow_h + 8
    else:
        ly = by0 + step_h + 18

ly += 40

# Dataset callout
draw_rounded_rect(draw, (left_x, ly, left_x + col_w, ly + 90),
                  radius=16, fill=BG_CARD, outline=ACCENT_TEAL, width=2)
ds_text = "~125,000 neurons  ·  ~54 million synapses"
dw = tw(draw, ds_text, font_callout)
draw.text((left_x + (col_w - dw) // 2, ly + 22), ds_text, font=font_callout, fill=ACCENT_TEAL)
ly += 130

# ─── RIGHT COLUMN — Key Findings ───────────────────────────────────────────
ry = y

draw.text((right_x, ry), "Key Findings", font=font_section, fill=ACCENT_GOLD)
ry += 105
draw_accent_line(draw, right_x, ry, right_x + col_w, ACCENT_GOLD, 3)
ry += 35

intro = "The analysis revealed several fundamental principles of neural circuit organization:"
ry = draw_text_wrapped(draw, intro, right_x, ry, col_w, font_body, TEXT_LIGHT, line_spacing=12)
ry += 28

findings = [
    ("37 Distinct Connectivity Motifs",
     "Identified as recurring building blocks of larger circuits, suggesting a modular "
     "wiring logic analogous to logic gates in digital circuits.",
     ACCENT_GOLD),
    ("Hub Neurons: Disproportionate Influence",
     "Only ~3.5% of the neuron population, yet accounting for over 28% of total synaptic "
     "output — indicating a highly non-uniform distribution of influence across the network.",
     ACCENT_CORAL),
    ("Layer-Specific Connectivity Rules",
     "Feedforward connections dominate between layers 2/3 → 4, while recurrent connections "
     "are enriched within layer 5 at a 4.7:1 recurrent-to-feedforward ratio.",
     ACCENT_BLUE),
    ("Cell-Type-Specific Wiring",
     "Inhibitory interneurons form connections with 6.2× higher specificity than excitatory "
     "neurons, challenging previous assumptions of broad inhibitory blanket coverage.",
     ACCENT_TEAL),
]

card_h = 210
for title, desc, accent_color in findings:
    draw_rounded_rect(draw, (right_x, ry, right_x + col_w, ry + card_h),
                      radius=16, fill=BG_CARD_LIGHT, outline=accent_color, width=2)

    # Left accent bar
    draw.rectangle([right_x + 2, ry + 14, right_x + 9, ry + card_h - 14], fill=accent_color)

    draw.text((right_x + 28, ry + 16), title, font=font_body_bold, fill=accent_color)
    draw_text_wrapped(draw, desc, right_x + 28, ry + 72, col_w - 60, font_body_small, TEXT_LIGHT, line_spacing=8)

    ry += card_h + 24

ry += 20

# Summary table
table_h = 340
draw_rounded_rect(draw, (right_x, ry, right_x + col_w, ry + table_h),
                  radius=16, fill=BG_CARD, outline=BORDER_SUBTLE, width=1)

draw.text((right_x + 35, ry + 18), "Summary of Quantitative Results", font=font_table_head, fill=ACCENT_TEAL)
draw_accent_line(draw, right_x + 30, ry + 65, right_x + col_w - 30, BORDER_SUBTLE, 2)

    ("Inhibitory specificity", "6.2× higher than excit."),

row_y = ry + 80
for finding, result in table_data:
    draw.text((right_x + 35, row_y), finding, font=font_table_val, fill=TEXT_LIGHT)

ry += table_h + 40

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# IMPLICATIONS — full width
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
imp_y = max(ly, ry) + 55

draw.text((margin + 35, imp_y + 18), "Implications & Future Directions", font=font_section, fill=ACCENT_TEAL)

    "These findings reshape our understanding of cortical computation. The discovery of modular "
    "connectivity motifs suggests that the brain employs a finite vocabulary of circuit elements, "
    "analogous to logic gates in digital circuits. The identification of hub neurons as "
    "disproportionate drivers of network activity has direct implications for understanding how "
    "focal lesions or targeted stimulation can produce widespread effects — relevant to both "
    "neurological disease and brain-computer interface design."
)
iy = draw_text_wrapped(draw, imp1, margin + 35, iy, content_w - 70, font_imp_body, TEXT_LIGHT, line_spacing=10)
iy += 20

imp2 = (
    "Future work will extend this connectomic approach to additional brain regions and species, "
    "with the ultimate goal of building a complete wiring diagram of the mammalian brain. The "
    "open-access dataset and analysis tools released alongside this publication are expected to "
    "accelerate discovery across the neuroscience community."
)
iy = draw_text_wrapped(draw, imp2, margin + 35, iy, content_w - 70, font_imp_body, TEXT_LIGHT, line_spacing=10)

footer_y = imp_y + imp_card_h + 55

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# FOOTER
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
draw_accent_line(draw, margin, footer_y, W - margin, BORDER_SUBTLE, 1)
footer_y += 22

footer_text = "Source: Nature (2024)  |  DOI: 10.1038/s41586-024-07487-w  |  Open-access dataset & tools available"
draw.text((margin, footer_y), footer_text, font=font_footer, fill=TEXT_MUTED)

draw.rectangle([0, H - 12, W, H], fill=ACCENT_BLUE)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# DECORATIVE — neural dot overlay
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
random.seed(42)
overlay = Image.new("RGBA", (W, H), (0, 0, 0, 0))
odraw = ImageDraw.Draw(overlay)

for _ in range(250):
    dx = random.randint(0, W)
    dy = random.randint(0, H)
    dr = random.randint(2, 8)
    alpha = random.randint(8, 30)
    c = random.choice([ACCENT_TEAL, ACCENT_BLUE, ACCENT_GOLD])
    odraw.ellipse([dx - dr, dy - dr, dx + dr, dy + dr], fill=(*c, alpha))

for _ in range(40):
    x1 = random.randint(0, W)
    y1 = random.randint(0, H)
    x2 = x1 + random.randint(-400, 400)
    y2 = y1 + random.randint(-300, 300)
    odraw.line([(x1, y1), (x2, y2)], fill=(*ACCENT_BLUE, random.randint(6, 18)), width=1)

img_rgba = img.convert("RGBA")
img_rgba = Image.alpha_composite(img_rgba, overlay)
img = img_rgba.convert("RGB")

# ─── Save ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
os.makedirs("/app/output", exist_ok=True)
output_path = "/app/output/final_poster.png"
img.save(output_path, "PNG", dpi=(300, 300))
print(f"Saved: {output_path}")
print(f"Dimensions: {img.size[0]} x {img.size[1]} px")
print(f"\nLayout check:")
print(f"  Left column ends:  ~{ly}")
print(f"  Right column ends: ~{ry}")
print(f"  Implications ends: ~{imp_y + imp_card_h}")
print(f"  Footer at:         ~{footer_y}")
print(f"  Canvas height:     {H}")
fill_pct = ((footer_y + 50) / H) * 100
print(f"  Fill ratio:        ~{fill_pct:.0f}%")

arguments.content:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate an academic conference poster for the Nature 2024 neural circuit mapping study.
Version 4 — fills A0 portrait canvas completely."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import os
import random

# ─── Dimensions & Colors ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
W, H = 3500, 4950

BG_NAVY       = (10, 16, 34)
BG_CARD       = (20, 32, 60)
BG_CARD_LIGHT = (26, 40, 72)
BG_QUOTE      = (14, 24, 48)
ACCENT_BLUE   = (0, 155, 255)
ACCENT_TEAL   = (0, 210, 185)
ACCENT_GOLD   = (255, 195, 40)
ACCENT_CORAL  = (255, 110, 100)
TEXT_WHITE     = (242, 247, 255)
TEXT_LIGHT     = (195, 205, 225)
TEXT_MUTED     = (120, 138, 170)
BORDER_SUBTLE  = (38, 58, 98)

FONT_DIR  = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/liberation"
FONT_DIR2 = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu"

def load_font(name, size):
    for d in [FONT_DIR, FONT_DIR2]:
        p = os.path.join(d, name)
        if os.path.exists(p):
            return ImageFont.truetype(p, size)
    return ImageFont.load_default()

# ─── Fonts ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
font_title       = load_font("LiberationSans-Bold.ttf", 140)
font_subtitle    = load_font("LiberationSans-Regular.ttf", 64)
font_citation    = load_font("LiberationSans-Italic.ttf", 46)
font_section     = load_font("LiberationSans-Bold.ttf", 80)
font_metric_val  = load_font("LiberationSans-Bold.ttf", 130)
font_metric_lbl  = load_font("LiberationSans-Regular.ttf", 42)
font_metric_ctx  = load_font("LiberationSans-Italic.ttf", 32)
font_body        = load_font("LiberationSans-Regular.ttf", 48)
font_body_bold   = load_font("LiberationSans-Bold.ttf", 48)
font_body_small  = load_font("LiberationSans-Regular.ttf", 40)
font_table_head  = load_font("LiberationSans-Bold.ttf", 42)
font_table_val   = load_font("LiberationSans-Regular.ttf", 38)
font_footer      = load_font("LiberationSans-Italic.ttf", 36)
font_method_lbl  = load_font("LiberationSans-Bold.ttf", 40)
font_method_desc = load_font("LiberationSans-Regular.ttf", 34)
font_callout     = load_font("LiberationSans-Bold.ttf", 44)
font_badge       = load_font("LiberationSans-Bold.ttf", 30)
font_imp_body    = load_font("LiberationSans-Regular.ttf", 42)
font_quote       = load_font("LiberationSans-Italic.ttf", 52)
font_quote_attr  = load_font("LiberationSans-Regular.ttf", 32)

# ─── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def draw_rounded_rect(draw, xy, radius, fill=None, outline=None, width=1):
    draw.rounded_rectangle(xy, radius=radius, fill=fill, outline=outline, width=width)

def tw(draw, text, font):
    bb = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=font)
    return bb[2] - bb[0]

def th(draw, text, font):
    bb = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=font)
    return bb[3] - bb[1]

def draw_text_wrapped(draw, text, x, y, max_width, font, fill, line_spacing=14):
    words = text.split()
    lines = []
    current = ""
    for word in words:
        test = (current + " " + word).strip()
        if tw(draw, test, font) <= max_width:
            current = test
        else:
            if current:
                lines.append(current)
            current = word
    if current:
        lines.append(current)
    for line in lines:
        draw.text((x, y), line, font=font, fill=fill)
        y += th(draw, line, font) + line_spacing
    return y

def draw_accent_line(draw, x0, y, x1, color=ACCENT_TEAL, width=3):
    draw.line([(x0, y), (x1, y)], fill=color, width=width)

def centered_text(draw, text, cx, y, font, fill):
    w = tw(draw, text, font)
    draw.text((cx - w // 2, y), text, font=font, fill=fill)

def draw_vertical_gradient(draw, xy, color_top, color_bot):
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = xy
    for y in range(y0, y1):
        t = (y - y0) / max(1, y1 - y0 - 1)
        c = tuple(int(color_top[i] + (color_bot[i] - color_top[i]) * t) for i in range(3))
        draw.line([(x0, y), (x1, y)], fill=c)

# ─── Create Image ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG_NAVY)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

draw_vertical_gradient(draw, (0, 0, W, 700), (24, 40, 76), BG_NAVY)

margin = 150
content_w = W - 2 * margin

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 1. HEADER
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
draw.rectangle([0, 0, W, 12], fill=ACCENT_BLUE)

y = 90

# Nature badge
draw_rounded_rect(draw, (margin, y, margin + 210, y + 52), radius=10, fill=ACCENT_GOLD)
centered_text(draw, "NATURE", margin + 105, y + 9, font_badge, BG_NAVY)
draw.text((margin + 230, y + 5), "2024", font=font_citation, fill=TEXT_MUTED)
y += 80

# Title
draw.text((margin, y), "Mapping Neural Circuit Architecture", font=font_title, fill=TEXT_WHITE)
y += 175
draw.text((margin, y), "Advances in Brain Connectivity Analysis", font=font_subtitle, fill=ACCENT_TEAL)
y += 90

# One-liner
draw_text_wrapped(draw,

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate an academic conference poster for the Nature 2024 neural circuit mapping study.
Version 4 — fills A0 portrait canvas completely."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import os
import random

# ─── Dimensions & Colors ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
W, H = 3500, 4950

BG_NAVY       = (10, 16, 34)
BG_CARD       = (20, 32, 60)
BG_CARD_LIGHT = (26, 40, 72)
BG_QUOTE      = (14, 24, 48)
ACCENT_BLUE   = (0, 155, 255)
ACCENT_TEAL   = (0, 210, 185)
ACCENT_GOLD   = (255, 195, 40)
ACCENT_CORAL  = (255, 110, 100)
TEXT_WHITE     = (242, 247, 255)
TEXT_LIGHT     = (195, 205, 225)
TEXT_MUTED     = (120, 138, 170)
BORDER_SUBTLE  = (38, 58, 98)

FONT_DIR  = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/liberation"
FONT_DIR2 = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu"

def load_font(name, size):
    for d in [FONT_DIR, FONT_DIR2]:
        p = os.path.join(d, name)
        if os.path.exists(p):
            return ImageFont.truetype(p, size)
    return ImageFont.load_default()

# ─── Fonts ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
font_title       = load_font("LiberationSans-Bold.ttf", 140)
font_subtitle    = load_font("LiberationSans-Regular.ttf", 64)
font_citation    = load_font("LiberationSans-Italic.ttf", 46)
font_section     = load_font("LiberationSans-Bold.ttf", 80)
font_metric_val  = load_font("LiberationSans-Bold.ttf", 130)
font_metric_lbl  = load_font("LiberationSans-Regular.ttf", 42)
font_metric_ctx  = load_font("LiberationSans-Italic.ttf", 32)
font_body        = load_font("LiberationSans-Regular.ttf", 48)
font_body_bold   = load_font("LiberationSans-Bold.ttf", 48)
font_body_small  = load_font("LiberationSans-Regular.ttf", 40)
font_table_head  = load_font("LiberationSans-Bold.ttf", 42)
font_table_val   = load_font("LiberationSans-Regular.ttf", 38)
font_footer      = load_font("LiberationSans-Italic.ttf", 36)
font_method_lbl  = load_font("LiberationSans-Bold.ttf", 40)
font_method_desc = load_font("LiberationSans-Regular.ttf", 34)
font_callout     = load_font("LiberationSans-Bold.ttf", 44)
font_badge       = load_font("LiberationSans-Bold.ttf", 30)
font_imp_body    = load_font("LiberationSans-Regular.ttf", 42)
font_quote       = load_font("LiberationSans-Italic.ttf", 52)
font_quote_attr  = load_font("LiberationSans-Regular.ttf", 32)

# ─── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def draw_rounded_rect(draw, xy, radius, fill=None, outline=None, width=1):
    draw.rounded_rectangle(xy, radius=radius, fill=fill, outline=outline, width=width)

def tw(draw, text, font):
    bb = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=font)
    return bb[2] - bb[0]

def th(draw, text, font):
    bb = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=font)
    return bb[3] - bb[1]

def draw_text_wrapped(draw, text, x, y, max_width, font, fill, line_spacing=14):
    words = text.split()
    lines = []
    current = ""
    for word in words:
        test = (current + " " + word).strip()
        if tw(draw, test, font) <= max_width:
            current = test
        else:
            if current:
                lines.append(current)
            current = word
    if current:
        lines.append(current)
    for line in lines:
        draw.text((x, y), line, font=font, fill=fill)
        y += th(draw, line, font) + line_spacing
    return y

def draw_accent_line(draw, x0, y, x1, color=ACCENT_TEAL, width=3):
    draw.line([(x0, y), (x1, y)], fill=color, width=width)

def centered_text(draw, text, cx, y, font, fill):
    w = tw(draw, text, font)
    draw.text((cx - w // 2, y), text, font=font, fill=fill)

def draw_vertical_gradient(draw, xy, color_top, color_bot):
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = xy
    for y in range(y0, y1):
        t = (y - y0) / max(1, y1 - y0 - 1)
        c = tuple(int(color_top[i] + (color_bot[i] - color_top[i]) * t) for i in range(3))
        draw.line([(x0, y), (x1, y)], fill=c)

# ─── Create Image ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG_NAVY)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

draw_vertical_gradient(draw, (0, 0, W, 700), (24, 40, 76), BG_NAVY)

margin = 150
content_w = W - 2 * margin

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 1. HEADER
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
draw.rectangle([0, 0, W, 12], fill=ACCENT_BLUE)

y = 90

# Nature badge
draw_rounded_rect(draw, (margin, y, margin + 210, y + 52), radius=10, fill=ACCENT_GOLD)
centered_text(draw, "NATURE", margin + 105, y + 9, font_badge, BG_NAVY)
draw.text((margin + 230, y + 5), "2024", font=font_citation, fill=TEXT_MUTED)
y += 80

# Title
draw.text((margin, y), "Mapping Neural Circuit Architecture", font=font_title, fill=TEXT_WHITE)
y += 175
draw.text((margin, y), "Advances in Brain Connectivity Analysis", font=font_subtitle, fill=ACCENT_TEAL)
y += 90

# One-liner
draw_text_wrapped(draw,
    "A comprehensive study revealing new principles of neural circuit organization through "
    "large-scale connectomics and functional mapping.",
    margin, y, content_w, font_body_small, TEXT_LIGHT, line_spacing=12)
y += 90

# DOI
draw.text((margin, y), "DOI: 10.1038/s41586-024-07487-w", font=font_citation, fill=ACCENT_GOLD)
y += 70

draw_accent_line(draw, margin, y, W - margin, ACCENT_BLUE, 3)
y += 55

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 2. METRICS BANNER
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
banner_y0 = y
banner_h = 480
draw_rounded_rect(draw, (margin, banner_y0, W - margin, banner_y0 + banner_h),
                  radius=24, fill=BG_CARD, outline=BORDER_SUBTLE, width=2)

draw_accent_line(draw, margin + 30, banner_y0 + 12, W - margin - 30, ACCENT_GOLD, 2)

metrics = [
    ("~125,000", "Neurons Mapped", "Reconstructed in connectome dataset", ACCENT_GOLD),
    ("~54M", "Synaptic Connections", "Individual synapses catalogued", ACCENT_GOLD),
    ("37", "Circuit Motifs", "Distinct recurring types found", ACCENT_TEAL),
    ("94.2%", "Classification Accuracy", "Automated neuron-type ID", ACCENT_BLUE),
]

n_m = len(metrics)
zone_w = content_w // n_m
cxs = [margin + zone_w * i + zone_w // 2 for i in range(n_m)]

for i, (val, label, ctx, val_color) in enumerate(metrics):
    cx = cxs[i]
    by = banner_y0 + 40

    draw.ellipse([cx - 7, banner_y0 + 22, cx + 7, banner_y0 + 36], fill=ACCENT_TEAL)

    centered_text(draw, val, cx, by, font_metric_val, val_color)
    centered_text(draw, label, cx, by + 175, font_metric_lbl, TEXT_WHITE)
    centered_text(draw, ctx, cx, by + 235, font_metric_ctx, TEXT_MUTED)

    if i < n_m - 1:
        sep_x = margin + zone_w * (i + 1)
        draw.line([(sep_x, banner_y0 + 60), (sep_x, banner_y0 + banner_h - 60)],
                  fill=BORDER_SUBTLE, width=1)

y = banner_y0 + banner_h + 70

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 3. HIGHLIGHT QUOTE STRIP
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
quote_y0 = y
quote_h = 130
draw_rounded_rect(draw, (margin, quote_y0, W - margin, quote_y0 + quote_h),
                  radius=16, fill=BG_QUOTE, outline=ACCENT_GOLD, width=2)

quote_text = "This work represents a step-change in scale and precision — mapping ~125,000 neurons and ~54 million synaptic connections."
qw = tw(draw, quote_text, font_quote)
draw.text((margin + (content_w - qw) // 2, quote_y0 + 18), quote_text, font=font_quote, fill=ACCENT_GOLD)

attr_text = "— Key message from the study"
aw = tw(draw, attr_text, font_quote_attr)
draw.text((margin + (content_w - aw) // 2, quote_y0 + 82), attr_text, font=font_quote_attr, fill=TEXT_MUTED)

y = quote_y0 + quote_h + 70

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 4. TWO-COLUMN LAYOUT
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
col_gap = 90
col_w = (content_w - col_gap) // 2
left_x = margin
right_x = margin + col_w + col_gap

# ─── LEFT COLUMN ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ly = y

# --- Background & Motivation ---
draw.text((left_x, ly), "Background & Motivation", font=font_section, fill=ACCENT_TEAL)
ly += 110
draw_accent_line(draw, left_x, ly, left_x + col_w, ACCENT_TEAL, 3)
ly += 40

bg1 = (
    "Understanding how the brain processes information requires detailed maps of neural "
    "connectivity. While classical neuroanatomy provided foundational insights, the field "
    "has long lacked the resolution and scale needed to capture complete circuit-level "
    "wiring diagrams."
)
ly = draw_text_wrapped(draw, bg1, left_x, ly, col_w, font_body, TEXT_LIGHT, line_spacing=14)
ly += 25

bg2 = (
    "Recent advances in electron microscopy, automated segmentation, and computational "
    "neuroscience have converged to make large-scale connectomics feasible. This study, "
    "published in Nature in 2024, represents a landmark effort to reconstruct and analyze "
    "neural circuits at unprecedented scale, bridging the gap between structural "
    "connectivity and functional organization."
)
ly = draw_text_wrapped(draw, bg2, left_x, ly, col_w, font_body, TEXT_LIGHT, line_spacing=14)
ly += 70

# --- Methodology ---
draw.text((left_x, ly), "Methodology & Technical Approach", font=font_section, fill=ACCENT_BLUE)
ly += 110
draw_accent_line(draw, left_x, ly, left_x + col_w, ACCENT_BLUE, 3)
ly += 40

meth_intro = (
    "The research team employed a multi-modal pipeline combining serial-section electron "
    "microscopy with advanced machine learning for automated neuron reconstruction:"
)
ly = draw_text_wrapped(draw, meth_intro, left_x, ly, col_w, font_body_small, TEXT_LIGHT, line_spacing=12)
ly += 40

steps = [
    ("Imaging", "Serial-section EM at 4 nm × 4 nm × 30 nm resolution"),
    ("Segmentation", "Deep learning neuron tracing + human proofreading"),
    ("Synapse Detection", "CNN classifier — 94.2% accuracy"),

    ("Validation", "Calcium imaging & optogenetic perturbation"),
]

            (bcx - 12, arr_y),
            (bcx + 12, arr_y),

ry += 40

ry = draw_text_wrapped(draw, intro, right_x, ry, col_w, font_body, TEXT_LIGHT, line_spacing=14)
ry += 30

    ("Cell-Type-Specific Wiring",

ry += 25

random.seed(42)

img = img_rgba.convert("RGB")

# ─── Save ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
os.makedirs("/app/output", exist_ok=True)
output_path = "/app/output/final_poster.png"
img.save(output_path, "PNG", dpi=(300, 300))
print(f"Saved: {output_path}")

print(f"  Left column ends:  ~{ly}")
print(f"  Right column ends: ~{ry}")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate an academic conference poster for the Nature 2024 neural circuit mapping study.
Version 4 — fills A0 portrait canvas completely."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import os
import random

# ─── Dimensions & Colors ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
W, H = 3500, 4950

BG_NAVY       = (10, 16, 34)
BG_CARD       = (20, 32, 60)
BG_CARD_LIGHT = (26, 40, 72)
BG_QUOTE      = (14, 24, 48)
ACCENT_BLUE   = (0, 155, 255)
ACCENT_TEAL   = (0, 210, 185)
ACCENT_GOLD   = (255, 195, 40)
ACCENT_CORAL  = (255, 110, 100)
TEXT_WHITE     = (242, 247, 255)
TEXT_LIGHT     = (195, 205, 225)
TEXT_MUTED     = (120, 138, 170)
BORDER_SUBTLE  = (38, 58, 98)

FONT_DIR  = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/liberation"
FONT_DIR2 = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu"

def load_font(name, size):
    for d in [FONT_DIR, FONT_DIR2]:
        p = os.path.join(d, name)
        if os.path.exists(p):
            return ImageFont.truetype(p, size)
    return ImageFont.load_default()

# ─── Fonts ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
font_title       = load_font("LiberationSans-Bold.ttf", 140)
font_subtitle    = load_font("LiberationSans-Regular.ttf", 64)
font_citation    = load_font("LiberationSans-Italic.ttf", 46)
font_section     = load_font("LiberationSans-Bold.ttf", 80)
font_metric_val  = load_font("LiberationSans-Bold.ttf", 130)
font_metric_lbl  = load_font("LiberationSans-Regular.ttf", 42)
font_metric_ctx  = load_font("LiberationSans-Italic.ttf", 32)
font_body        = load_font("LiberationSans-Regular.ttf", 48)
font_body_bold   = load_font("LiberationSans-Bold.ttf", 48)
font_body_small  = load_font("LiberationSans-Regular.ttf", 40)
font_table_head  = load_font("LiberationSans-Bold.ttf", 42)
font_table_val   = load_font("LiberationSans-Regular.ttf", 38)
font_footer      = load_font("LiberationSans-Italic.ttf", 36)
font_method_lbl  = load_font("LiberationSans-Bold.ttf", 40)
font_method_desc = load_font("LiberationSans-Regular.ttf", 34)
font_callout     = load_font("LiberationSans-Bold.ttf", 44)
font_badge       = load_font("LiberationSans-Bold.ttf", 30)
font_imp_body    = load_font("LiberationSans-Regular.ttf", 42)
font_quote       = load_font("LiberationSans-Italic.ttf", 52)
font_quote_attr  = load_font("LiberationSans-Regular.ttf", 32)

# ─── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def draw_rounded_rect(draw, xy, radius, fill=None, outline=None, width=1):
    draw.rounded_rectangle(xy, radius=radius, fill=fill, outline=outline, width=width)

def tw(draw, text, font):
    bb = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=font)
    return bb[2] - bb[0]

def th(draw, text, font):
    bb = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=font)
    return bb[3] - bb[1]

def draw_text_wrapped(draw, text, x, y, max_width, font, fill, line_spacing=14):
    words = text.split()
    lines = []
    current = ""
    for word in words:
        test = (current + " " + word).strip()
        if tw(draw, test, font) <= max_width:
            current = test
        else:
            if current:
                lines.append(current)
            current = word
    if current:
        lines.append(current)
    for line in lines:
        draw.text((x, y), line, font=font, fill=fill)
        y += th(draw, line, font) + line_spacing
    return y

def draw_accent_line(draw, x0, y, x1, color=ACCENT_TEAL, width=3):
    draw.line([(x0, y), (x1, y)], fill=color, width=width)

def centered_text(draw, text, cx, y, font, fill):
    w = tw(draw, text, font)
    draw.text((cx - w // 2, y), text, font=font, fill=fill)

def draw_vertical_gradient(draw, xy, color_top, color_bot):
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = xy
    for y in range(y0, y1):
        t = (y - y0) / max(1, y1 - y0 - 1)
        c = tuple(int(color_top[i] + (color_bot[i] - color_top[i]) * t) for i in range(3))
        draw.line([(x0, y), (x1, y)], fill=c)

# ─── Create Image ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG_NAVY)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

draw_vertical_gradient(draw, (0, 0, W, 700), (24, 40, 76), BG_NAVY)

margin = 150
content_w = W - 2 * margin

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 1. HEADER
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
draw.rectangle([0, 0, W, 12], fill=ACCENT_BLUE)

y = 90

# Nature badge
draw_rounded_rect(draw, (margin, y, margin + 210, y + 52), radius=10, fill=ACCENT_GOLD)
centered_text(draw, "NATURE", margin + 105, y + 9, font_badge, BG_NAVY)
draw.text((margin + 230, y + 5), "2024", font=font_citation, fill=TEXT_MUTED)
y += 80

# Title
draw.text((margin, y), "Mapping Neural Circuit Architecture", font=font_title, fill=TEXT_WHITE)
y += 175
draw.text((margin, y), "Advances in Brain Connectivity Analysis", font=font_subtitle, fill=ACCENT_TEAL)
y += 90

# One-liner
draw_text_wrapped(draw,
    "A comprehensive study revealing new principles of neural circuit organization through "
    "large-scale connectomics and functional mapping.",
    margin, y, content_w, font_body_small, TEXT_LIGHT, line_spacing=12)
y += 90

# DOI
draw.text((margin, y), "DOI: 10.1038/s41586-024-07487-w", font=font_citation, fill=ACCENT_GOLD)
y += 70

draw_accent_line(draw, margin, y, W - margin, ACCENT_BLUE, 3)
y += 55

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 2. METRICS BANNER
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
banner_y0 = y
banner_h = 480
draw_rounded_rect(draw, (margin, banner_y0, W - margin, banner_y0 + banner_h),
                  radius=24, fill=BG_CARD, outline=BORDER_SUBTLE, width=2)

draw_accent_line(draw, margin + 30, banner_y0 + 12, W - margin - 30, ACCENT_GOLD, 2)

metrics = [
    ("~125,000", "Neurons Mapped", "Reconstructed in connectome dataset", ACCENT_GOLD),
    ("~54M", "Synaptic Connections", "Individual synapses catalogued", ACCENT_GOLD),
    ("37", "Circuit Motifs", "Distinct recurring types found", ACCENT_TEAL),
    ("94.2%", "Classification Accuracy", "Automated neuron-type ID", ACCENT_BLUE),
]

n_m = len(metrics)
zone_w = content_w // n_m
cxs = [margin + zone_w * i + zone_w // 2 for i in range(n_m)]

for i, (val, label, ctx, val_color) in enumerate(metrics):
    cx = cxs[i]
    by = banner_y0 + 40

    draw.ellipse([cx - 7, banner_y0 + 22, cx + 7, banner_y0 + 36], fill=ACCENT_TEAL)

    centered_text(draw, val, cx, by, font_metric_val, val_color)
    centered_text(draw, label, cx, by + 175, font_metric_lbl, TEXT_WHITE)
    centered_text(draw, ctx, cx, by + 235, font_metric_ctx, TEXT_MUTED)

    if i < n_m - 1:
        sep_x = margin + zone_w * (i + 1)
        draw.line([(sep_x, banner_y0 + 60), (sep_x, banner_y0 + banner_h - 60)],
                  fill=BORDER_SUBTLE, width=1)

y = banner_y0 + banner_h + 70

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 3. HIGHLIGHT QUOTE STRIP
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
quote_y0 = y
quote_h = 130
draw_rounded_rect(draw, (margin, quote_y0, W - margin, quote_y0 + quote_h),
                  radius=16, fill=BG_QUOTE, outline=ACCENT_GOLD, width=2)

quote_text = "This work represents a step-change in scale and precision — mapping ~125,000 neurons and ~54 million synaptic connections."
qw = tw(draw, quote_text, font_quote)

ly += 25

bg2 = (
    "Recent advances in electron microscopy, automated segmentation, and computational "
    "neuroscience have converged to make large-scale connectomics feasible. This study, "
    "published in Nature in 2024, represents a landmark effort to reconstruct and analyze "
    "neural circuits at unprecedented scale, bridging the gap between structural "
    "connectivity and functional organization."
)
ly = draw_text_wrapped(draw, bg2, left_x, ly, col_w, font_body, TEXT_LIGHT, line_spacing=14)
ly += 70

# --- Methodology ---
draw.text((left_x, ly), "Methodology & Technical Approach", font=font_section, fill=ACCENT_BLUE)
ly += 110
draw_accent_line(draw, left_x, ly, left_x + col_w, ACCENT_BLUE, 3)
ly += 40

meth_intro = (
    "The research team employed a multi-modal pipeline combining serial-section electron "
    "microscopy with advanced machine learning for automated neuron reconstruction:"
)
ly = draw_text_wrapped(draw, meth_intro, left_x, ly, col_w, font_body_small, TEXT_LIGHT, line_spacing=12)
ly += 40

steps = [
    ("Imaging", "Serial-section EM at 4 nm × 4 nm × 30 nm resolution"),
    ("Segmentation", "Deep learning neuron tracing + human proofreading"),
    ("Synapse Detection", "CNN classifier — 94.2% accuracy"),
    ("Circuit Analysis", "Graph-theoretic motif detection & clustering"),
    ("Validation", "Calcium imaging & optogenetic perturbation"),
]

step_h = 120
arrow_h = 26

for idx, (label, desc) in enumerate(steps):
    by0 = ly

    draw_rounded_rect(draw, (left_x, by0, left_x + col_w, by0 + step_h),
                      radius=14, fill=BG_CARD_LIGHT, outline=BORDER_SUBTLE, width=1)

    bcx = left_x + 48
    bcy = by0 + step_h // 2
    draw.ellipse([bcx - 26, bcy - 26, bcx + 26, bcy + 26], fill=ACCENT_BLUE)
    centered_text(draw, str(idx + 1), bcx, bcy - 15, font_method_lbl, BG_NAVY)

    draw.text((left_x + 92, by0 + 18), label, font=font_method_lbl, fill=ACCENT_GOLD)
    draw_text_wrapped(draw, desc, left_x + 92, by0 + 62, col_w - 120, font_method_desc, TEXT_LIGHT, line_spacing=6)

    if idx < len(steps) - 1:

        draw.polygon([

draw_accent_line(draw, right_x, ry, right_x + col_w, ACCENT_GOLD, 3)
ry += 40

draw_accent_line(draw, margin, footer_y, W - margin, BORDER_SUBTLE, 1)

draw.text((margin, footer_y), footer_text, font=font_footer, fill=TEXT_MUTED)

draw.rectangle([0, H - 12, W, H], fill=ACCENT_BLUE)

# DECORATIVE — neural dot overlay
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
random.seed(42)
overlay = Image.new("RGBA", (W, H), (0, 0, 0, 0))
odraw = ImageDraw.Draw(overlay)

for _ in range(300):

img_rgba = img.convert("RGBA")
img_rgba = Image.alpha_composite(img_rgba, overlay)
img = img_rgba.convert("RGB")

# ─── Save ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
os.makedirs("/app/output", exist_ok=True)
output_path = "/app/output/final_poster.png"
img.save(output_path, "PNG", dpi=(300, 300))
print(f"Saved: {output_path}")
print(f"Dimensions: {img.size[0]} x {img.size[1]} px")
print(f"\nLayout check:")
print(f"  Left column ends:  ~{ly}")
print(f"  Right column ends: ~{ry}")
print(f"  Implications ends: ~{imp_y + imp_card_h}")

print(f"  Canvas height:     {H}")
